data.title_japanese: シャドウバースF（フレイム）
data.synopsis:
Shadowverse Flame features a new protagonist Light Tenryu and its story is set in Shadowverse College, a facility that trains professional players of the Shadowverse game. Tenryu Light, a transfer student, decides to join "Seventh Flame," one of the seven Shadowverse clubs. However, Seventh Flame is on the verge of closure due to a lack of members! In order to avoid the club's demise, Light decides to look for new members. But what awaits him are powerful rivals who control a wide variety of cards...

(Source: Crunchyroll)

title_synonyms: Records of a Guidance Counselor's Hypnotic Sex Life
data.synopsis: An episodic story that follows the sexual exploits of Fukama, a sleazy teacher who gets ahold of a notebook called the Sex Life Guidance Notebook, which has supernatural powers. When its user writes the name of a person and acts the user wants them to perform, the target is hypnotized to comply with the user's orders. Fukama uses this book to have his way with various female students he lusts after, stealing them from their love interests who are unaware of what he's doing. Each episode focuses on a different female character that Fukama hypnotizes.

data.title: Kaitou Queen wa Circus ga Osuki
data.title_japanese: 怪盗クイーンはサーカスがお好き
data.synopsis:
The phantom thief known as the Mirage Queen is an enigma. From their age and gender to the methods behind their daring heists, much remains unknown to authorities and investigators worldwide. However, Queen's few accomplices know them as a remarkably principled person, guided by an internal code and a belief in the artistry of theft. As Queen announces their next target—the legendary jewel called Rose of Linden—the public holds its breath in anticipation. But when thieves from a traveling circus claim the jewel first, it sparks a contest of deception that promises to take everyone involved by surprise.

[Written by MAL Rewrite]
